live_acceptance.consent: Both approval links from the tool results opened OpenKey with the requester line From a link that names mcp.tinycloud.xyz, the warning that OpenKey cannot confirm the sender, and Your approval will be delivered to the TinyCloud MCP service. Read-only metadata run https://github.com/TinyCloudLabs/openkey/actions/runs/43863690032 shows the earlier refresh record revoked and a new one issued at 2026-11-16T11:54:10Z under the same session and authentication time; the tool calls that followed succeeded.
